text: A dead trunk, leaning on nothing much. {lead} puts its shoulder to it and over it goes with a crack. Underneath: Souvenir Thimble.
A cheese wheel stuck in a hollow, as they do. {lead} gives it a shove and down the slope it goes, and the hollow gives up some loose change and a gratitude card.
The bowl sails over the bend like it knew the road. {lead} trots after it, and finds Sloes in the grass.
A knot of sheep, all facing the wrong way. {lead} works them in a neat curve until the gate is clear. Left on the post for you: Cream Tea.
Soft ground, a patient creature, and a lot of worms. {lead} brings up the lot, and under them: Peat.
{lead} shoves the dead trunk over the gap, where it lands with a satisfying thump. You walk across, arms out like a tightrope act.
You cross back over the trunk, arms out. {lead} goes under the stream bank, which is its own business.
{lead} taps out a steady beat beside the hill and the earth begins to wriggle. Turned up with the worms: Four-Leaf Clover.
